ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   D. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   D. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Say Pillars of Islam has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Islam.

   D. Use Pillars of Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic etiquettes? (1 mark)

   B. Use Islamic etiquettes to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic etiquettes.
   D. Apply the teaching of Islamic etiquettes with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

12. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic phrases? (1 mark)

   C. Use Islamic phrases to insult classmates of other faiths.

14. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily
